summary: Validated backend + frontend for newly added official sources (Official LaLiga page source and Official Bundesliga RSS) and verified no regression in admin diagnostics/public story flows.

minor.issue: NewsAPI.org provider intermittently/consistently returns HTTP 401 at provider-level; app handles this as a provider failure without breaking response.

action_items: Optional: Investigate/fix NewsAPI key/account status to reduce external provider failed diagnostics noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend test module depends on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL being present in runtime env; if unset, full module skips. Consider loading env in pytest config for deterministic CI behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter8 added a targeted backend assertion test for Official LaLiga (provider official_page, candidateCount > 0) and Official Bundesliga RSS (provider rss, httpStatus != 301). UI automation verified /admin/stories provider names render and public story modal still works without diagnostics leakage.
rca of the issue: No app-side regression found for requested source additions. External NewsAPI provider 401 is upstream credential/provider-level behavior; backend correctly degrades by marking provider as failed while preserving overall diagnostics/story response.
